description: Curated IT skills taxonomy for JobMatch AI. Used by the spaCy PhraseMatcher to extract skills from CV and job description text. Matching is case-insensitive, so aliases are stored lowercase. Short ambiguous surface forms are deliberately excluded because they match ordinary English or, in the case of 'cv', appear in every resume: bare go, r, c, d, cv, ps, ad, dr, ha, ia, va. Note that the lowercase canonical name is therefore not always present in the aliases list.
